name: Multi-Channel Message Formatting
prompt:
Read the message.json file on the desktop. Create a new outputs folder on the desktop, and then generate the following three files:

1. outputs/telegram.txt: plain text. Use *subject* for the bold subject, then a blank line, then the body, then a blank line, and finally each link on its own line in the format “label: link address”.
2. outputs/slack.json: a JSON object containing a blocks array. Use the Slack format: one header block for the subject, one section block for the body (type mrkdwn), and then a separate section block for each link, with the link written as <link address|label>.
3. outputs/email.txt: email format. The first line is Subject: ..., the second line is From: ..., the third line is To: ... (these contents are taken from the message JSON), then a blank line, then the body, then a blank line, and finally each link on its own line in the format “label — link address”.

The original subject, body, sender, recipient, and links in the message must be fully retained in every format without omission.
